Subject: an experienced gray-haired male QA engineer around 55–60. Thick silver-gray hair, short at the sides and neatly swept back on top, entirely gray rather than a small gray streak. Silver eyebrows, a neatly trimmed short gray beard and mustache, lean mature facial structure and believable fine age lines. Alert, analytical expression with one slightly raised eyebrow and a very subtle dry smile, as though he has just spotted an overlooked edge case. Human-sized features and grounded adult proportions.
Signature eye/glasses: EXACTLY ONE prominent artificial optical eye / cybernetic monocle over the eye on the viewer's LEFT. It should read as an advanced single-eye inspection instrument integrated with his face. The other eye is an uncovered natural gray-green eye, visibly looking toward the camera. No second lens, no pair of conventional glasses and no full-width VR visor. Keep the device compact enough that his face remains dominant. Non-gory integration, no wounds.
Additional cybernetics: restrained small ear interface and a thin neck port with integrated cyan status lights, consistent with the existing collection. Most of the face is natural human skin.
Wardrobe: the collection's charcoal technical jacket with a structured raised collar, tactile worn dark fabric, small brushed-metal fasteners, an understated amber-brown shoulder inset and a narrow cyan detail, over a simple dark crew-neck shirt. Practical engineer clothing, no armor, badges, lettering or props.
Pose and framing: STRICTLY FRONTAL head-and-shoulders portrait, head upright, eye line level, shoulders square and level, looking directly into camera. Match the reference's close-up avatar scale and upper-chest crop. Full hairstyle inside frame with around 8–10 percent top safety margin. Face and single optical lens centered for circle and rounded-square avatar crops.
Background: fully opaque flat saturated AMBER, target #E9A21B, filling the entire square and all four corners. No magenta, no scenery, no gradient, no pattern, no circle or vignette.
Rendering: match the reference's premium detailed stylized 3D game-character portrait, natural mature skin, sculpted facial planes, convincing gray hair, realistically shaded cloth, brushed metal and optical glass, soft warm-neutral studio key and restrained cool rim light. Clean continuous silhouette and readable identity at small UI sizes.
No glitch effects, floating cubes, shards, pixel displacement, chromatic doubling, scan lines, holograms, oversized eyes, cute/chibi/anime style, face mask, text, watermark, decorative border, extra characters, hands or multi-panel layout. One square avatar only.
